title: Eightfold reading ornaments
authorship: Original vector constructions for the reading companions; not reproductions of a museum object.
construction: An eight-point outline from two equal squares rotated 45 degrees, an inscribed octagon, a smaller eight-point repeat, and a connecting square lattice.
context: Inspired by the repeated circle-and-square geometry documented in Islamic architectural and decorative arts. Nested repeats provide detail at two scales; this is not a claim that the ornament is a historical fractal or carries a specific sacred meaning.

sources.title: Geometric Patterns in Islamic Art
sources.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Department of Islamic Art

sources.title: Unit 3: Geometric Design in Islamic Art

usage: Decorative borders and section separators only. No scripture, pseudo-calligraphy, doctrinal symbolism, or text background. Hidden from assistive technology.
